description: Lets the real CI-Server web app (served remotely at http://127.0.0.1:8642 / http://localhost:8642 after the bootstrap page's window.location.replace()) offer "Download recommended model" in Settings > Model when the person's own Ollama lacks a model this app pulls into its own Ollama: get_recommended_model_command says which are missing and how a download is going, download_recommended_model_command starts one. Neither takes an argument, so the page cannot choose what is pulled: the list is ollama_sidecar::RECOMMENDED_MODELS. See src-tauri/src/local_model/recommended.rs.
